title: Apple (AAPL) Now Covered by
text:
Posted by ABMN Staff on Apr 5th, 2018 // No Comments 
Equities research analysts at initiated coverage on shares of Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) in a research report issued to clients and investors on Wednesday, October 25th, Marketbeat.com reports. The firm set a “buy” rating and a $193.00 price target on the iPhone maker’s stock. ‘s price objective would indicate a potential upside of 11.30% from the stock’s previous close. 
Several other research analysts have also issued reports on AAPL. Pacific Crest reissued an “equal weight” rating on shares of Apple in a research report on Wednesday, June 28th. Citigroup reissued a “buy” rating and issued a $160.00 target price on shares of Apple in a research report on Tuesday, July 4th. Instinet reissued a “buy” rating and issued a $165.00 target price on shares of Apple in a research report on Wednesday, July 5th. Nomura reissued a “buy” rating and issued a $165.00 target price on shares of Apple in a research report on Wednesday, July 5th. Finally, Raymond James Financial reissued an “outperform” rating and issued a $163.00 target price on shares of Apple in a research report on Thursday, July 6th. One equities research analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, eighteen have given a hold rating, thirty-one have issued a buy rating and one has assigned a strong buy rating to the company. The stock currently has a consensus rating of “Buy” and a consensus target price of $202.52. Get Apple alerts: 
Shares of NASDAQ:AAPL traded up $1.80 during trading on Wednesday, hitting $173.41. The stock had a trading volume of 22,327,751 shares, compared to its average volume of 37,308,980. Apple has a 12 month low of $140.06 and a 12 month high of $183.50. The firm has a market capitalization of $854,413.06, a P/E ratio of 18.82, a P/E/G ratio of 1.28 and a beta of 1.25. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74, a quick ratio of 1.20 and a current ratio of 1.24. Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last announced its earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, topping the consensus estimate of $3.82 by $0.07. Apple had a return on equity of 37.37% and a net margin of 21.13%. The firm had revenue of $88.29 billion during the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $87.62 billion. During the same quarter in the prior year, the company earned $3.36 EPS. The business’s revenue was up 12.7% compared to the same quarter last year. equities analysts forecast that Apple will post 11.37 EPS for the current fiscal year. 
In other Apple news, insider Daniel J. Riccio sold 15,641 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction dated Friday, January 5th. The stock was sold at an average price of $174.78, for a total transaction of $2,733,733.98. Following the sale, the insider now directly owns 13,739 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $2,401,302.42. The transaction was disclosed in a legal filing with the SEC, which is available through this hyperlink . 0.08% of the stock is owned by company insiders.

About Apple 
Apple Inc (Apple) designs, manufactures and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players, and a variety of related software, services, peripherals, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. The Company’s products and services include iPhone, iPad, Mac, iPod, Apple TV, a portfolio of consumer and professional software applications, the iOS and OS X operating systems, iCloud, and a variety of accessory, service and support offerings.
